needs.what: Cross-camera pair precision/recall and MTMC IDF1 on Dhaka
needs.status: not measured - needs footage from >=2 cameras with an overlapping set of vehicles, and a hand-made table mapping (camera, local track id) -> global vehicle id for >=40 vehicles seen on both cameras (docs/EVALUATION.md section 6). The footbridge labels named in SUPERVISION X6 are not in the repo. Metrics are implemented and tested (evaluation/retrieval.py: pair_precision_recall, mtmc_idf1)
